Custom-mode shader skeleton.description: A full custom-mode .shader file: program directive plus both entry points

Canvas-mode shader skeleton.description: A canvas_item .shader file using the sprite template (no vertex() needed)

program directive.description: Required once, before every other directive

shader_type canvas_item.description: Opt into the sprite-template lowering (default is custom)

variant directive.description: One extra program variant, compiled with #define <NAME> (1)

batched directive.description: canvas_item only - also emit the batched twin program

render_mode directive.description: Blend/shading modes stored as the RenderModes bitmask

precision directive.description: Float precision of the auto-emitted GL_ES fragment prologue

vertex entry point.description: The vertex stage body, spliced verbatim into main()

fragment entry point.description: The fragment stage body; COLOR is the output and is undefined until written

fixed_function block (generic).description: Console fixed-function pass list serving every backend without a more specific block

fixed_function block (per backend).description: Fixed-function block overriding the generic one for specific backends

fixed_function pipeline block.description: Bind the effect to a backend pipeline stage instead of a pass list

pass declaration.description: One bundle of hardware state, submitted over the sprite quad

sampler uniform with texture unit.description: Sampler uniform with an explicit texture_unit(N) hint

std140 instance block.description: The engine's standard per-sprite uniform block

varying declaration.description: Lowered to an out in the vertex stage and an in in the fragment stage

attribute declaration.description: A vertex attribute - emitted in the vertex stage only

stage conditional.description: Compile-time stage conditional (rarely needed - only the #ifdef/#ifndef forms are legal)

software-renderer conditional.description: Resolved when a stage source is built; only --emit-sw-generated defines it

include.description: Textual include, relative to this file, up to depth 8
